scripts.docs:clean: uv run --frozen sphinx-build -M clean docs/source docs/_build
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:clean && uv run --frozen sphinx-build -W --keep-going -d docs/_build/doctrees -b html docs/source docs/_build/html
scripts.docs:deploy: npm run docs:build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.docs.jsonc --strict
scripts.docs:deploy:dry-run: npm run docs:build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.docs.jsonc --dry-run --strict
